Package hadur2.core.adapt

Class OpeningBook

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.adapt.OpeningBook
public final class OpeningBook extends Object
Reads a profile's tiers once and turns them into an Opening (the artifact's "Recognise, then adapt"). It is a pure function of the profile: it takes no tick, round or clock, so no decision here can come from elapsed time alone (DIAL-2).
  • ADAPT-1: movement tier M2 or M3 (a surfer) starts on the anti-surfer gun; M0 or M1 on the main gun. An unknown tier leaves the choice to live data, as 1.20 did.
  • ADAPT-2: gun tier T3 turns the flattener views on from the first surfable wave, whatever their own thresholds say. Any known gun tier also hands the profile's hit rate to the surf, which reads it in place of the live one while the profile's is the more certain, so the simple, normal and recent views start where the last battle left them rather than where a stranger starts.
  • ADAPT-3: the seeds start at SEED_WEIGHT, half a live sample, and are replayed only when the tier they back is known.
  • DIAL-1: a tier whose estimate is too uncertain is unknown (see Tiers), and an unknown tier selects the conservative setting, 1.20's.
  • ADAPT-5: the profile's lead-aware verdict (POW-7's hit-rate condition at the last battle's end) passes through as Opening.leadAware(), for the core to apply from the first shot.
  • SHIELD-3: the profile's shielder flag passes through as Opening.shielder(), so the core treats the enemy as a bullet shielder from the first shot.
  • S5: the gun tier also sets the starting distance (Opening.distance): close against a gun that cannot hit, further out the better it is. A stranger starts at 1.20's 650 px.
